items.example: She always takes the bus to work.
items.simple: Every time, with no breaks. The sun comes up every morning, again and again.
items.note: Sıklık zarfı; geniş zamanda genelde fiilden önce gelir.

items.example: I usually get up at seven.
items.simple: Most days, but not every single day. You do it a lot.
items.note: Sıklık zarfı; geniş zamanda genelde fiilden önce gelir.

items.example: We often eat out on Fridays.
items.exampleTr: Cuma günleri sık sık dışarıda yemek yeriz.
items.simple: Many times, again and again. It happens a lot, but not all the time.
items.note: Sıklık zarfı; geniş zamanda genelde fiilden önce gelir.

items.example: Sometimes I walk home from work.
items.simple: Not every day, only on some days. It happens now and then.

items.example: I never drink coffee at night.
items.simple: Not one time, ever. It does not happen at all.
items.note: Zaten olumsuz anlam taşır; yanına "not" gelmez.

items.example: Can I use your phone for a second?
items.simple: You take a thing and do something with it, like a spoon for eating.

items.example: Our new neighbours are really friendly.
items.exampleTr: Yeni komşularımız gerçekten çok cana yakın.
items.simple: Nice to other people. A kind child who smiles and wants to play is like this.

items.example: It'll probably rain later.
items.simple: It will most likely happen. You are not sure, but you think yes.

items.example: He talks about football all the time.
items.simple: Every minute, without stopping. Your heart does it day and night.
items.note: Cümle sonunda kullanılır; bazen şikâyet tonu taşır.

items.example: Most of the time I cook at home.
items.simple: Many times, but not each time. It is nearly always.

items.example: I had to explain it a second time.
items.exampleTr: Bunu ikinci kez açıklamak zorunda kaldım.
items.simple: Once more. You did it one time, and now you do it again.

items.example: There's a cat on the roof.
items.simple: The top of a house. It keeps the rain off your head.

items.example: Call me if there’s an emergency.
items.exampleTr: Acil bir durum olursa beni ara.
items.simple: A big problem that happens fast. You need help right now.

items.example: Your English is really improving!
items.simple: Make something better than before. Your drawing was bad, and now it is good.

items.example: I try to avoid sugar these days.
items.simple: Stay away from something bad. You walk around a puddle so your feet stay dry.
items.note: Ardından fiil gelirse -ing alır: avoid eating.

items.example: Wear a hat to prevent sunburn.
items.exampleTr: Güneş yanığını önlemek için şapka tak.
items.simple: Stop a bad thing before it happens. You hold the cup so it does not fall.
items.note: Kalıp: prevent someone from doing something.

items.example: Dogs aren't allowed in the shop.
items.simple: Say yes so someone can do it. Mum says you can have a cookie.

items.example: I rarely watch TV anymore.
items.simple: Not many times. It happens only a few times, and you almost never see it.
items.note: Sıklık zarfı; geniş zamanda genelde fiilden önce gelir.

items.example: We hardly ever see each other now.
items.simple: Almost never. You can count the times on one hand.
items.note: Olumsuz anlamlıdır; cümleye "not" eklenmez.

items.example: I occasionally go running in the park.
items.simple: Not often, just one time here and one time there.

items.example: I still call him from time to time.
items.simple: Sometimes, but not often. You do it, then wait a long time, then do it again.

items.example: I mostly work from home.
items.simple: Nearly all, or most of the time. Most of the cake is gone.

items.example: I generally go to bed before midnight.
items.simple: In most cases. It is the usual way.

items.example: This bus is frequently late.
items.simple: Very often. It happens again and again, many times.
items.note: "Often" ile aynı anlamda, biraz daha resmi.

items.example: She's determined to pass the exam.
items.simple: You really want to do it and you will not stop. You keep trying and trying.

items.example: His room is always so neat.
items.exampleTr: Odası her zaman çok derli toplu.
items.simple: Clean and in the right place. Your toys are in a line and your room looks nice.
items.note: Günlük konuşmada "harika" anlamında da kullanılır: That's neat!

items.example: The kids ran excitedly to the door.
items.simple: In a very happy way, because a fun thing is coming. You jump and shout.
items.note: Sıfat hali: excited (heyecanlı).

items.example: I finally persuaded him to come with us.
items.exampleTr: Sonunda onu bizimle gelmeye ikna ettim.
items.simple: You talk to someone until they say yes. "Please, please, come and play with me!"
items.note: Birini bir şey YAPMAYA razı etmek: persuade someone to do.

items.example: I'm not convinced he's telling the truth.
items.simple: You say things until someone believes you. Then they think the same as you.
items.note: Birini bir şeyin DOĞRU olduğuna inandırmak (mantıkla).

items.example: The firefighters rescued a cat from the tree.
items.simple: Take someone out of danger. A strong person gets a kitten down from a tall tree.

items.example: Thanks for making the effort to come.
items.exampleTr: Gelmek için çaba gösterdiğin için teşekkürler.
items.simple: You work very hard to do something. You use all your power to lift a big box.
items.note: Kalıp: make an effort (çaba göstermek).

items.example: About fifty people attended the wedding.
items.simple: Go to a place and be there. You go to school every day.
items.note: "attend to" değil; doğrudan nesne alır: attend a meeting.

items.example: Smoking can cause heart disease.
items.simple: Something that makes a body sick. A cold is a small one.

items.example: Our flight was delayed by two hours.
items.simple: Make something come late. You wait longer than you wanted to.

items.example: The job involves a lot of travelling.
items.exampleTr: Bu iş çok fazla seyahat gerektiriyor.
items.simple: To have or need something as a part. A cake needs eggs, milk and sugar.

items.example: Stop acting like a child!
items.simple: To be or do things in some way. If you act silly, you do funny things.
items.note: "act like" = gibi davranmak.

items.example: The land around here is really flat.
items.simple: Smooth, with no bumps or hills. A table top is like this.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesinde isim olarak "daire, apartman dairesi" de demek.

items.example: Please form a line by the door.
items.simple: Make a shape. You squeeze clay and make a ball.

items.example: He injured his knee playing football.
items.simple: Hurt a body. You fall down and your knee gets a cut.
items.note: Pasif çok yaygın: get injured / be injured.

items.example: Production stopped because of the strike.
items.simple: Making things to sell. A big place makes lots of toys, and this is what it does.

items.example: Cars pollute the air in big cities.
items.simple: Make the air, water or ground dirty. Dirty smoke and trash make the world sick.

items.example: Is your question related to the exam?
items.simple: Joined to something or like it. A cat is like a lion. They are in the same family.

items.example: I've been there a number of times.
items.simple: Some, more than two or three. It is like a bunch of apples.
items.note: Ardından çoğul isim ve çoğul fiil gelir.

items.example: Sleep plays an important role in your health.
items.exampleTr: Uyku sağlığında önemli bir rol oynar.
items.simple: Be a big and needed part of something. Without this one, the game would not go well.
items.note: Kalıp: play a role in something.

items.en: This bridge dates back to the Ottoman period.
items.example: This bridge dates back to the Ottoman period.
items.simple: The bridge was made a very long time ago, and it is still here now.
items.note: Kalıcı gerçekler geniş zamanla anlatılır: it dates back to…

items.example: This house dates back to the 1920s.
items.simple: Start a very long time ago. It was made in the old days and it is still here.
items.note: Geniş zamanla kullanılır, -ing almaz.

items.example: Our friendship goes back to primary school.
items.simple: To start long ago and still be here. This game goes back to the time of our grandpas.

items.example: The film was so dull I fell asleep.
items.exampleTr: Film o kadar sıkıcıydı ki uyuyakaldım.
items.simple: Not bright and not fun. Boring and gray, like a dark, cloudy day.

items.example: There's a peculiar smell in the kitchen.
items.simple: A little bit strange. It looks or feels not like the others.

items.example: The house has a vast garden.
items.simple: Very, very big. It goes on and on, like the sea or the sky.

items.example: He was casually dressed in jeans and a T-shirt.
items.simple: Easy and relaxed, like you do not think about it. You wear old clothes and just walk.
items.note: Sıfat hali: casual (rahat, gündelik).

items.example: "No," she said firmly.
items.simple: Strong and not moving. You hold your hand tight and it will not slip.
items.note: Sıfat hali: firm (kararlı, sağlam).

items.example: She was typing furiously on her laptop.
items.simple: In a very angry way. You shout and stamp your feet.

items.example: The rain was an unwelcome surprise.
items.simple: Not wanted. A guest comes, but nobody asked them to come.

items.example: She was wearing an emerald-green dress.
items.simple: A bright, pretty green color, like a shiny green stone.

items.example: Your shirt is all wrinkled.
items.simple: Full of little lines and folds. Old skin or crumpled paper looks like this.

items.example: She bought a cute spotted dress.
items.simple: Covered in little dots. A ladybug is red with black dots on it.

items.example: It's a gloomy day, let's stay in.
items.simple: Dark and sad. The sky is gray and nobody feels happy.
items.note: İnsan için: karamsar, morali bozuk.

items.example: The towels are still damp.
items.simple: A little bit wet, not dry. A towel that was just used feels like this.
items.note: Genelde rahatsız edici nem için kullanılır.

items.example: Don't eat that bread, it's mouldy.
items.simple: Old food or walls with fuzzy green stuff growing on them. It smells bad.
items.note: Amerikan yazımı: moldy.

items.example: Take your shoes off, they’re filthy!
items.simple: Very, very dirty. Your shoes after playing in deep mud are like this.

items.example: She played the wicked stepmother in the play.
items.exampleTr: Oyunda kötü kalpli üvey anneyi oynadı.
items.simple: Very bad and mean. A bad witch in a story is like this.
items.note: Argo İngiliz kullanımında "harika" da demek: That's wicked!

items.example: It's a bit chilly, take a jacket.
items.simple: A little bit cold. You want a coat on.
items.note: İnsan tavrı için: soğuk, mesafeli.

items.example: Don't be so bossy, I can do it myself!
items.exampleTr: Bu kadar emir verme, kendim yapabilirim!
items.simple: Likes to tell other people what to do. "Do this! Do that!"

items.example: I'm completely wiped after that trip.
items.simple: Very, very tired. After a long day of play, you have no power left.
items.note: Gündelik/argo; "exhausted" yerine. Friends: "I'm officially wiped."

items.example: In a nutshell, we need more time.
items.exampleTr: Kısacası, daha fazla zamana ihtiyacımız var.
items.simple: Said in a few words. It is the short story of something big.
items.note: Resmi konuşmada da kullanılabilir.

items.example: Better late than never, as they say.
items.exampleTr: Dedikleri gibi, geç olsun güç olmasın.
items.simple: This is what people say. It starts a well-known saying.
items.note: Kartta "as it is said"; günlük dilde "as they say" denir.

items.example: I treat myself to cake now and then.
items.simple: Not every day, only some days. It happens a little, here and there.
items.note: "every now and then" şeklinde de çok yaygın.

items.example: We still meet up now and again.
items.simple: Sometimes, but not often. It happens a little, here and there.

items.example: At times I really miss my hometown.
items.simple: Some of the time, but not all the time.

items.example: I barely slept last night.
items.simple: Only just. You can almost not do it, but you do it a tiny bit.
items.note: Olumsuz anlamlıdır; "not" ile kullanılmaz.

items.example: We seldom go out during the week.
items.simple: Not often at all. It happens only a few times, and you hardly see it.
items.note: "Rarely" ile aynı; biraz daha edebî.

items.example: Smoking is not permitted inside.
items.simple: Say yes, you can do it. Mum says you may stay up a little late.
items.note: "Allow"dan daha resmi; tabelalarda sık görülür.

items.example: We had to postpone the party until next week.
items.exampleTr: Partiyi gelecek haftaya ertelemek zorunda kaldık.
items.simple: Do it later, not now. You will play after you eat.
items.note: Bilerek ileri tarihe atmak; "delay" ise gecikme de olabilir.

items.example: My phone is constantly ringing today.
items.simple: All the time, never stopping. The baby cries and cries and cries.

items.example: Would you like some herbal tea?
items.simple: Made from plants. Tea made from leaves and flowers is like this.

items.example: The bridge is made of steel.
items.simple: A very hard, strong metal. A knife or a big bridge can be made from it.

items.example: He bought some shares in a tech company.
items.simple: A part of something that is yours. You can own a small part of a big shop.

items.example: The knight pulled out his sword.
items.simple: A long, sharp knife for fights. A knight in a story holds one.

items.example: Smoke was coming out of the chimney.
items.simple: A tall pipe on a roof where smoke goes out. A fire is under it.

items.example: She was wearing pointed shoes.
items.simple: Thin and sharp at the end. A pencil is like this at the end.

items.example: The board will make the final decision.
items.simple: A group of top people. They sit at a table and make big choices for a company.

items.example: Housing is really expensive in this city.
items.exampleTr: Bu şehirde konut gerçekten çok pahalı.
items.simple: Places where people live, like houses and flats.

items.example: The factory was dumping toxic waste into the river.
items.simple: Bad stuff from a factory that can make you sick. People throw it away.
items.note: "waste" genelde sayılamaz: toxic waste.

items.example: My grandfather served in a military unit in the east.
items.exampleTr: Dedem doğuda bir askeri birlikte görev yaptı.
items.simple: A group of soldiers. They work together and have one boss.

items.example: I can't distinguish the twins.
items.simple: See that two things are not the same. You can tell which is a cat and which is a dog.
items.note: Kalıp: distinguish between A and B.

items.example: She devotes her weekends to her kids.
items.simple: Give all your time to one thing. You play with your toys all day and do nothing else.
items.note: Kalıp: devote something to someone/something.

items.example: The baby is starting to crawl.
items.simple: Move slowly on your hands and knees, like a baby does.

items.example: The plane began to descend.
items.simple: Go down. You walk from the top of the stairs to the bottom.

items.example: I tripped on the stairs and hurt my foot.
items.exampleTr: Merdivende ayağım takıldı ve ayağımı incittim.
items.simple: Your foot hits something and you almost fall. Watch out for that rock!
items.note: "trip someone (up)" = çelme takmak. İsim olarak: gezi.

items.example: Be careful, you might slip on the ice.
items.simple: Your foot slides, and you almost fall down. A banana peel can do it.
items.note: Kaza eseri kayıp düşmek; slide ise kontrollü, keyifli kaymak.

items.example: The kids love sliding down the hill in winter.
items.simple: Go smooth and easy over something. A child goes down a playground slide.
items.note: Kontrollü, bilerek kaymak (kaydırak, buz).

items.example: We wandered around the old town all afternoon.
items.exampleTr: Bütün öğleden sonra eski şehirde gezindik.
items.simple: Walk around with no plan. You go here and there, with nowhere to be.

items.example: Let's stroll along the beach after dinner.
items.exampleTr: Akşam yemeğinden sonra sahilde yürüyüş yapalım.
items.simple: Walk slowly and happily. You are not in a hurry. You look at things.

items.example: She marched into the office and quit.
items.exampleTr: Ofise dik dik yürüyüp girdi ve istifa etti.
items.simple: Walk with big, even steps, like a soldier. One, two, one, two!
items.note: Kararlı/öfkeli yürüyüş için de kullanılır.

items.example: We sneaked out of the party early.
items.simple: Move very quietly so no one sees you. A cat does it when it wants a bird.
items.note: Amerikan İngilizcesinde geçmiş hali "snuck" da olur.

items.example: Technology is advancing so fast.
items.simple: Move forward. You go in front, a little more every time.
items.note: İsim: ilerleme, avans. "in advance" = önceden.

items.example: We rowed across the lake.
items.simple: You push a boat through the water with long sticks.
items.note: İsim olarak "sıra" (/rəʊ/) ya da "kavga" (/raʊ/).

items.example: Can you reverse into that parking space?
items.exampleTr: O park yerine geri geri girebilir misin?
items.simple: Go the other way. You turn around and go back.

items.example: He leaned against the wall and waited.
items.simple: You do not stand up straight. You put your back on a wall to rest.
items.note: Sıfat olarak: yağsız, ince kaslı (lean meat).

items.example: Can I extend my stay for two more nights?
items.exampleTr: Kalışımı iki gece daha uzatabilir miyim?
items.simple: Make it longer or bigger. You pull a rubber band, and it gets longer.

items.example: Don't overtake on a bend!
items.simple: Go past another car or person because you are faster. You go in front.

items.example: I commute to work by train.
items.simple: Go from home to work every day and back again. Many people do it.
items.note: İsim de olur: It’s a long commute.

items.example: Let me illustrate this with an example.
items.simple: Show with a picture or a story. It helps people see what you mean.

items.example: I managed to negotiate a better price.
items.exampleTr: Daha iyi bir fiyat için pazarlık etmeyi başardım.
items.simple: Talk with someone until you both say yes. You and your friend agree how to share toys.

items.example: He claims he saw a ghost.
items.simple: Say that something is true, even if you have not shown it. "It is mine!"

items.example: Don't insult my cooking!
items.simple: Say something mean to make a person feel bad. Words that hurt.
items.note: İsim: /ˈɪnsʌlt/ (hakaret) — vurgu başa kayar.

items.example: Stop teasing your little sister!
items.simple: Make fun of someone, a little bit. Sometimes it is funny and sometimes it is mean.
items.note: Dostça, şakacı takılma; mock ise acımasız alay.

items.example: We didn't anticipate so much traffic.
items.simple: Think about what will come, and get ready. You know it will rain and take an umbrella.
items.note: Önceden sezip ona göre hazırlanmak anlamı da var.

items.example: I need some time to reflect on what happened.
items.exampleTr: Olanlar üzerine düşünmek için biraz zamana ihtiyacım var.
items.simple: Think quietly about what you did, to learn from it. Was it good or bad?
items.note: Geçmişe, kendi davranışlarına dönüp düşünmek: reflect on.

items.example: We'll evaluate the results next week.
items.simple: Think about how good something is. A teacher looks at your work and says how good it is.
items.note: Değerine/kalitesine karar vermek (içinde "value" var).

items.example: The doctor needs to assess your injury first.
items.simple: Look at something and say how good or how big it is. You think about it first.
items.note: Mevcut durumu ölçmek, analiz etmek (risk, hasar, sınav).

items.example: They're trying to determine the cause of the fire.
items.simple: Find out what is true. You look at clues, and then you know for sure.

items.example: So what did you conclude from all this?
items.exampleTr: Peki bütün bunlardan ne sonuç çıkardın?
items.simple: Think and then say, "This is what I think." You decide at the end.

items.example: I always associate this song with summer.
items.simple: Join in your head. You think of one thing, and it makes you think of another.
items.note: Kalıp: associate A with B.

items.example: I can totally relate to that.
items.exampleTr: Bunu çok iyi anlıyorum, aynısını yaşadım.
items.simple: To see how two things go together. Or to feel 'I am like that too' about someone.
items.note: "I can relate" = kendimi senin yerine koyabiliyorum.

items.example: He finally revealed the secret.
items.simple: Show something that was hidden. You pull the cloth and show what is under it.

items.example: She can trace her family back to the 1700s.
items.simple: Find where something came from, going back. It is like following footprints.
items.note: Kalıp: trace something back to…

items.example: This church dates from the 12th century.
items.simple: Come from a time long ago. It started a very long time ago.
items.note: "date back to" ile aynı anlam.

items.example: If Mum finds out, you're dead meat!
items.simple: A person who is in very big trouble. Someone will be very angry with them.
items.note: Çok argo; tehdit ya da şaka amaçlı.

items.example: On some level, I think he knew the truth.
items.simple: In a small way, deep inside you. You feel it a little, even if you do not say it.

items.example: We found a curiously shaped stone on the beach.
items.exampleTr: Sahilde tuhaf şekilli bir taş bulduk.
items.simple: A shape that looks strange and funny. It is not like other shapes.

items.example: My dad gave me a stern look.
items.exampleTr: Babam bana sert bir bakış attı.
items.simple: Very serious and not smiling. Like a teacher with a hard face.

items.example: He was enraged by the referee’s decision.
items.simple: Very, very angry. Your face is red and you shout.

items.example: The teacher was a tall, severe-looking woman.
items.exampleTr: Öğretmen uzun boylu, sert görünümlü bir kadındı.
items.simple: A person who looks hard and a little scary. The face is cross.

items.example: That was downright careless of you.
items.simple: Fully, completely. It is not just a little bit. It is all of it.
items.note: Genelde olumsuz sıfatı güçlendirir: downright rude/careless.

items.example: Your picture is a bit crooked.
items.simple: Not straight. It bends the wrong way, like a bent stick.
items.note: Mecazi: dürüst olmayan, yolsuz (a crooked cop).

items.example: "Not again!" she said, exasperated.
items.simple: Very cross because you try and try, and it still does not work.

items.example: She has piercing blue eyes.
items.simple: A high, sharp sound that hurts your ears. It goes deep into your head.

items.example: The view from the top was astounding.
items.simple: So big a surprise that your mouth opens. You cannot believe it.

items.example: He has a funny squeaky voice.
items.simple: A high little sound, like a mouse. A toy that you squeeze goes like this.

items.example: The alarm made a shrill noise.
items.exampleTr: Alarm kulak tırmalayan bir ses çıkardı.
items.simple: A very high, loud sound that hurts your ears, like a whistle.

items.example: My headphones are always tangled.
items.simple: All mixed up in knots. Your hair or string can look like this.

items.example: We heard muffled voices from the next room.
items.simple: A sound you can hardly hear, like talking through a pillow.
items.note: Fiil olarak: sesi boğmak (muffle a laugh).

items.example: This wool jumper is so scratchy.
items.simple: Rough and itchy on your skin, like a wool jumper.
items.note: "a scratchy throat" = gıcık yapan boğaz.

items.example: I had a cold and streaming eyes all week.
items.simple: Running with lots of water, like eyes full of tears when you cry hard.
items.note: Kalıp: streaming eyes / a streaming cold.

items.example: They were talking in hushed voices.
items.simple: Very quiet. You speak in a small voice so no one else hears.
items.note: Genelde "hushed voices / tones" kalıbıyla.

items.example: She wore a maroon velvet dress.
items.simple: A dark red-brown color. It is a bit like a dark apple.

items.example: Her lip was quivering as she tried not to cry.
items.simple: Shaking a little, because you are cold or scared.
items.note: Korku, heyecan ya da soğuktan hafif titreme.

items.example: The sauce is lumpy, keep stirring.
items.simple: Bumpy, not smooth. Porridge with little hard bits in it is like this.

items.example: He was wearing a ragged old coat.
items.exampleTr: Yırtık pırtık eski bir palto giyiyordu.
items.simple: Old, torn, and not neat. Old clothes with holes look like this.

items.example: The dog barked ferociously at the postman.
items.simple: In a very strong, angry way, like a wild animal.

items.example: "Fine," he said stiffly.
items.simple: In a hard way, not bending. You walk with straight legs, like a robot.
items.note: Sıfat hali: stiff (sert, kaskatı).

items.example: I could faintly hear music downstairs.
items.simple: In a very small way. You can hardly see it or hear it.
items.note: Sıfat hali: faint (zayıf, belli belirsiz).

items.example: My grandpa has big bushy eyebrows.
items.simple: Thick, with lots of hair, sticking out. A fox tail looks like this.

items.example: They have a big shaggy dog.
items.simple: Long, thick hair that is not neat, like a big dog.

items.example: Don't be so judgmental, you don't know her.
items.exampleTr: Bu kadar yargılayıcı olma, onu tanımıyorsun.
items.simple: A person who thinks others are bad, and says so. They point a finger at you.

items.example: This lighting is really unflattering.
items.exampleTr: Bu ışık insanı gerçekten kötü gösteriyor.
items.simple: Not nice, and it makes you look bad. A hat that makes you look silly.
items.note: Kıyafet, ışık, fotoğraf için sık kullanılır.

items.example: These boots are really durable.
items.simple: Strong, and lasts a long time. Even if you drop it, it is fine.
items.note: "durable goods" = dayanıklı tüketim malları.

items.example: The noise from next door is excessive.
items.simple: Too much. More than you need. Too many sweets is too much.

items.example: I overlooked a small mistake in the report.
items.exampleTr: Rapordaki küçük bir hatayı gözden kaçırdım.
items.simple: Not see something that is there. You walk past and you do not look.
items.note: Ayrıca: (manzaraya) bakmak — a room overlooking the sea.

items.example: She had her ears pierced when she was ten.
items.simple: Make a small hole with something sharp. A needle goes through cloth.

items.example: She was a pioneer in women’s football.
items.simple: The first one to do something new. Others come after.

items.example: Prices fluctuate a lot in summer.
items.simple: Go up and down, up and down, again and again, like hot and cold days.
items.note: Değer, sayı ya da miktar için kullanılır.

items.example: Take an umbrella, just as a precaution.
items.simple: Something you do first so a bad thing does not happen. You wear a helmet.
items.note: Kalıp: take precautions (önlem almak).

items.example: The lion was watching its prey.
items.simple: An animal that another animal hunts to eat. A mouse is this for a cat.

items.example: Smoking is prohibited in the building.
items.simple: Say no, you may not. A sign says you must not do it.
items.note: Resmi; tabelalarda yaygın. Günlük dilde "ban".

items.example: Mosquitoes can transmit diseases.
items.simple: Send something from one place to another. A phone sends sound.
items.note: Sinyal, bilgi, hastalık ya da enerji için.

items.example: It was such an absorbing book, I read it in one day.
items.exampleTr: O kadar sürükleyici bir kitaptı ki bir günde okudum.
items.simple: So fun that you do not want to stop. Your eyes stay on a good book.

items.example: Kids need to learn to discriminate between right and wrong.
items.exampleTr: Çocukların doğruyu yanlıştan ayırt etmeyi öğrenmesi gerek.
items.simple: Treat some people badly, and others well. It is not fair.
items.note: "discriminate against" = ayrımcılık yapmak (olumsuz).

items.example: I stumbled on the last step.
items.simple: Hit your foot and almost fall. Your foot catches on a rock.
items.note: "stumble upon/across" = tesadüfen rastlamak.

items.example: The swans glided across the lake.
items.simple: Move smooth and easy, like a bird in the sky or a skater on ice.

items.example: We spent the summer roaming around Europe.
items.simple: Walk around a big place with no plan. Wild horses go here and there over the land.
items.note: Wander'dan farkı: geniş alanlarda serbestçe dolaşmak.

items.example: The cat retreated under the bed.
items.simple: Go back and run away from a fight. You step back, because it is too hard.
items.note: İsim olarak: sığınak, dinlenme yeri (a weekend retreat).

items.example: Please proceed to gate 5.
items.simple: Go on. You were stopped, and now you start again.
items.note: Talimatlarda/anonslarda yaygın, resmi tondadır.

items.example: The train came to a sudden halt.
items.simple: Stop. You stand still, and you do not go on.
items.note: Kalıp: come to a halt (durmak).

items.example: Sorry, I have to dash — I'm late!
items.simple: Run fast for a short time. A runner goes as fast as they can.
items.note: "dash someone's hopes" = umutlarını yıkmak.

items.example: He strode into the room without knocking.
items.exampleTr: Kapıyı çalmadan uzun adımlarla odaya girdi.
items.simple: Walk with long, big steps. You know where you are going.

items.example: He's been limping since the match.
items.simple: Walk with a sore leg. You hurt your foot, and it hurts to walk.

items.example: This table wobbles a bit.
items.simple: Shake from side to side, not steady. A table with a short leg does it.
items.note: Mecazen: kararsız kalıp bocalamak.

items.example: My hands were trembling before the interview.
items.simple: Shake a little, because you are cold or scared.
items.note: Genelde korku, soğuk ya da heyecandan.

items.example: I need to withdraw some cash.
items.simple: Take back. You pull your hand away. Or take money out of the bank.

items.example: I'm calling to inquire about the flat.
items.exampleTr: Daire hakkında bilgi almak için arıyorum.
items.simple: Ask a question to find out. You want to know more, so you ask.
items.note: "ask"in resmi hali; İngiliz yazımı: enquire.

items.example: I vowed never to go back there.
items.exampleTr: Oraya bir daha asla gitmeyeceğime yemin ettim.
items.simple: Say, "I will really do it. I promise." It is a very strong promise.
items.note: İsim: yemin (wedding vows).

items.example: Stop mocking my accent!
items.simple: Copy someone to be funny and unkind. You say the same words in a silly voice.
items.note: Genelde taklit edip küçük düşürmek; tease'ten daha kırıcı.

items.example: He muttered something and left.
items.simple: Talk in a low voice that people can hardly hear, because you are not happy.
items.note: Genelde sinirle, kısık sesle, dişlerinin arasından.

items.example: Stop mumbling, I can't understand you!
items.simple: Talk in a low, soft way, and the words are not clear.
items.note: Ağzının içinde, anlaşılmaz konuşmak.

items.example: She murmured "good night" and fell asleep.
items.simple: A soft, low sound. Water in a stream sounds this way. Or a quiet voice.
items.note: Yumuşak, alçak ve huzurlu bir tonla.

items.example: He stutters when he gets nervous.
items.simple: You say a word again and again, and it gets stuck. "B-b-b-ball."
items.note: Sesleri tekrarlayarak kekelemek.

items.example: He's always boasting about his car.
items.simple: Say how great you are. "I am the best! I can do it!"
items.note: Kalıp: boast about something.

items.example: Don't contradict me in front of the kids!
items.simple: Say the opposite. "No, it is not like that."
items.note: İki ifade için: birbiriyle çelişmek.

items.example: I'm contemplating moving abroad.
items.exampleTr: Yurt dışına taşınmayı ciddi ciddi düşünüyorum.
items.simple: Think about something for a long time. You look at the sky and think.
items.note: Geleceğe dair bir olasılığı sessizce, uzun uzun düşünmek.

items.example: I sat there pondering what to do next.
items.exampleTr: Orada oturup bundan sonra ne yapacağıma kafa yordum.
items.simple: You think about something slowly and carefully, for a long time.
items.note: Zor bir karar ya da sorun üzerine zihinde tartmak.

items.example: From his accent, I deduced he was Scottish.
items.simple: Find the answer from small clues. You see wet shoes and know it rained.
items.note: Mantık ve kanıtla adım adım sonuca varmak.

items.example: What can we infer from her silence?
items.simple: Make a good guess from what you know. You see a gray sky and guess rain.
items.note: İpuçlarından, ima edilenden sonuç çıkarmak.

items.example: You can't reason with him when he's angry.
items.simple: Think step by step to find the answer. If this is true, then that is true.
items.note: "reason with someone" = birini mantıkla ikna etmeye çalışmak.

items.example: People perceive things differently.
items.simple: See, hear or understand something. You notice what is there with your eyes and mind.

items.example: A beefy security guard stopped us at the door.
items.exampleTr: İri yapılı bir güvenlik görevlisi bizi kapıda durdurdu.
items.simple: Big and strong with big muscles, like a big, strong man.

items.example: He stared glumly out of the window.
items.simple: In a sad, quiet way. You frown and you do not talk.
items.note: Sıfat hali: glum (kederli, mahzun).

items.example: "What now?" she asked irritably.
items.exampleTr: "Yine ne var?" diye sinirli sinirli sordu.
items.simple: In a cross way. You are not happy, and you snap at people.

items.example: He came in with ruffled hair.
items.simple: Messy, not neat. Hair after wind is like this. Or a bird with its feathers up.
items.note: Mecazi: keyfi kaçmış, sinirlenmiş (feel ruffled).

items.example: She gingerly picked up the broken glass.
items.simple: Slow, careful and gentle. You step on thin ice softly, so it does not break.

items.example: My brother gleefully told Mum what I did.
items.exampleTr: Kardeşim ne yaptığımı anneme sevinçle anlattı.
items.simple: In a very happy way. You laugh and rub your hands.
items.note: Çoğu zaman başkasının başına gelenden zevk alma tonu.

items.example: That was the fateful night we met.
items.simple: Something that changes a life. It was a big day and it changed everything.
items.note: Genelde talihsiz ya da çok önemli sonuçlu anlar için.

items.example: The old man gave me a whiskery kiss.
items.exampleTr: Yaşlı adam bana kıllı bir öpücük verdi.
items.simple: It has thin hair on its face, like a cat or a mouse.

items.example: The stars shone in the inky sky.
items.simple: Black like ink. Very, very dark, like night.
items.note: Genelde "inky sky / inky darkness" kalıbında.

items.example: My grandma has knobbly old hands.
items.exampleTr: Büyükannemin boğum boğum yaşlı elleri var.
items.simple: Lumpy and bumpy, with bumps all over, like old knees or a tree.
items.note: Kemikli yapılar için: knobbly knees.

items.example: She sank into a big squashy armchair.
items.simple: Soft and a little wet, so you can squeeze it. Like a ripe peach.

items.example: He let out a strangled cry.
items.simple: Sounding like it is hard to speak, like something is stuck in the throat.
items.note: Genelde "a strangled cry/voice" kalıbında.

items.example: The basement smells musty.
items.simple: Smells old and a bit wet, like a closed room that nobody uses.

items.example: This bread's gone stale.
items.simple: Not fresh. Old bread that is hard and dry is like this.
items.note: Hava için: havasız, ağır (stale air).

items.example: He gave me a sheepish grin.
items.simple: A little bit shy and silly, because you did something wrong.

items.example: "Who's that foxy lady?"
items.simple: Very nice to look at, in a grown-up way. People think this person is very pretty.
items.note: Eski moda ama hâlâ kullanılan argo bir iltifat.

items.example: After the marathon I could only hobble home.
items.exampleTr: Maratondan sonra eve ancak aksayarak gidebildim.
items.simple: Walk slowly with a limp, as if your foot is sore.
items.note: Kısa, dengesiz adımlarla (yaşlılık, yorgunluk).

items.example: She stammered an apology and ran out.
items.exampleTr: Kekeleyerek özür diledi ve dışarı koştu.
items.simple: Talk and stop, and say the first part again, because it is hard.
items.note: Genelde utanç, korku ya da şaşkınlık anında duraksayarak.

items.example: The cat retracted its claws.
items.simple: Pull back in. A turtle takes its head into its shell. Or take back what you said.
items.note: Mecazen: söylediği sözü geri almak.

items.example: I can't envision myself living anywhere else.
items.exampleTr: Kendimi başka bir yerde yaşarken hayal edemiyorum.
items.simple: Make a picture in your head. You think about how something will look later.

items.example: Lions and tigers are carnivorous animals.
items.simple: An animal that eats other animals. A lion is one.
items.note: Genelde "carnivorous animal/plant" kalıbında.

items.example: Athlete’s foot is a common fungal infection.
items.exampleTr: Ayak mantarı yaygın bir mantar enfeksiyonudur.
items.simple: Like a mushroom or mould. It grows on old and damp things.
items.note: Çoğunlukla tıp ve biyolojide: fungal infection.

items.example: Hundreds of people perished in the earthquake.
items.simple: Die, or be gone. It is the end, and it does not come back.
items.note: Yiyecekler için: bozulmak, çürümek (perishable food).

items.example: The high price deters a lot of tourists.
items.simple: Make someone not want to do something. A big "no" sign makes you not go.
items.note: Kalıp: deter someone from doing something.

items.example: In the end, common sense prevailed.
items.simple: Win in the end. The good one is the strongest, and the bad one loses.
items.note: Fikir/âdet için: yaygın olmak, hüküm sürmek.
